name: Cohesivo CMS (eZ Platform lineage)
description_en:
The assigned eZ Platform Enterprise Edition is a legacy product name. Official sources trace eZ Platform through Ibexa DXP to the current Cohesivo CMS brand, while the broader Ibexa name now covers a marketing platform and several products. This profile preserves the legacy slug and makes that lineage explicit instead of combining the whole group’s capabilities.

For an existing installation, first identify its exact release and support status: the official service table places eZ Platform2.5LTS end of life in March2024. For a new project, evaluate the current Cohesivo offer and vendor-linked documentation with its own deployment, seat and integration scope. New branding does not upgrade old software or transfer every new entitlement to it.
description_zh:
原分配的eZ Platform Enterprise Edition是旧产品名。官方来源将eZ Platform、Ibexa DXP与当前Cohesivo CMS品牌串联；更广的Ibexa名称现在覆盖营销平台及多个产品。本档案保留旧slug，明确承接关系，不把集团全部能力混成一个单品。

已有安装应先识别确切版本及支持状态：官方服务表将eZ Platform2.5 LTS结束服务列为2024年3月。新项目则需评估当前Cohesivo方案及厂商链接文档的部署、席位及集成范围；更名不会升级旧软件，也不会将全部新权益自动转移给它。

core_features.name_zh: 结构化内容及可视化页面
core_features.explanation_zh: 当前CMS提供内容表单、复用区块、预览及可视化建页，属当前范围，不保证每个旧版均有。
当前文档描述草稿/审阅/发布及按安装配置的工作流，审阅队列受角色限制。
Standard从一站、按席位SaaS开始；Advanced宣传PaaS/本地、不限席位及更多开发访问。

pricing.summary_zh: 不复用旧Enterprise价。当前Cohesivo Standard按席位SaaS，Advanced为不限席位PaaS/本地，均从一站开始；实读文本未公布数字费用/站点/资源/AI容量。

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Follow the CMS lineage rather than the parent-platform redirect
sections.title_zh: 沿CMS承接关系核查，不能只看母平台跳转
sections.en:
The oldez.noaddress now reachesIbexa’s current corporate platform. That redirect alone would not identify a like-for-like CMS. The developer portal explicitly saysIbexaDXPreplaced theeZPlatformname inOctober2020,and Cohesivo’s own history now explains that Cohesivo carries forward theCMS/DXPexperience whileIbexa names the broader orchestration platform. The current pricing page repeats the new-name relationship.

This record therefore points to Cohesivo while retaining the assigned eZslug. RaptorCDP,QuablePIM,ActitoandQualifioare separate group products; their presence in navigation is not an included feature/license for thisCMS. ExistingEnterprisecontracts and installed modules need their own inventory.

Earlier transition evidence: [Ibexa developer portal](https://developers.ibexa.co/).
sections.zh:
旧ez.no地址现进入Ibexa企业平台，但跳转本身不足以确认同等CMS。开发门户明确称Ibexa DXP于2020年10月替换eZ Platform名称，Cohesivo自身历史则解释其承接CMS/DXP体验，而Ibexa用于更广编排平台；当前定价页也重复更名关系。

因此本记录指向Cohesivo并保留原eZ slug。Raptor CDP、Quable PIM、Actito及Qualifio是不同集团产品，出现在导航不等于本CMS包含其功能/许可。已有Enterprise合同和已装模块需独立盘点。

早期更名证据：[Ibexa开发门户](https://developers.ibexa.co/)。

sections.title_en: Identify end-of-service installations before planning content work
sections.title_zh: 内容改造前识别已结束服务的安装
sections.en:
The official Enterprise service table listseZPlatform2019LTS(v2.5)with maintenance endingMarch2022and end of lifeMarch2024;v1.13endsDecember2021. It also listsIbexaDXP3.3LTSend of lifeJune2026. These are concrete release-specific dates,not an assertion that the entire currentCMSis retired. LaterLTSrows have their own timelines and any contract-specific extension remains to be confirmed.

For an inherited site, record the actual release,PHP/runtime,extensions,custom templates,content/permission model and support agreement. A content edit is not a supported upgrade path. Plan migration and rollback for the installed version instead of copying current screenshots,APIexamplesorAIfeatures into a legacy capability list.

Lifecycle source: [official service-life table](https://support.ibexa.co/public/service-life).
sections.zh:
官方Enterprise服务表列eZ Platform2019 LTS(v2.5)于2022年3月结束维护、2024年3月结束服务，v1.13于2021年12月结束服务；Ibexa DXP3.3 LTS则为2026年6月。这些是具体版本日期，不表示整个当前CMS已退役。后续LTS各有时间线，合同专属延长仍需确认。

接手旧站应记录实际版本、PHP/运行环境、扩展、定制模板、内容/权限模型和支持合同。编辑内容不是受支持升级路径，应按已装版本规划迁移及回退，不能将当前截图、API例或AI功能复制到旧版功能表。

生命周期来源：[官方服务期限表](https://support.ibexa.co/public/service-life)。

sections.title_en: Create a typed content item and verify the right site preview
sections.title_zh: 创建有类型内容，并核对正确站点预览
sections.en:
The current vendor-linked user guide starts creation from a selected parent in Content structure or a dashboard action,then asks for location,base language and content type. Required fields must be completed before saving. An editor can preview with a selectedSiteAccess,save a draft,send for review,publish now orschedule later according to the installation’s permissions. Editing creates a new content version;forms/pages are specifically associated with the documentedExperience/Commerceeditions.

For an illustrative product article,choose its content type and language,link the approved image,preview the targetSiteAccessand submit it to the intended reviewer. Test the public version separately. This is current-documentation guidance,not an executed flow or evidence that every legacyEnterpriseedition has the same UI.

Procedure: [create/edit content items](https://doc.ibexa.co/projects/userguide/en/latest/content_management/create_edit_content_items/).
sections.zh:
当前厂商链接用户指南从Content structure选父条目或dashboard动作创建，再选择位置、基础语言及内容类型；必填字段需补齐才可保存。编辑者可选SiteAccess预览、存草稿、送审、立即或定时发布，受安装权限影响。编辑创建新版本，表单/页面特别关联文档中的Experience/Commerce版本。

例如产品文章可选类型及语言、关联获准图片、预览目标SiteAccess并提交指定审阅者，再独立检查公开版本。上述依据当前文档，未经执行，也不证明每个旧Enterprise版本有相同界面。

操作来源：[创建/编辑内容条目](https://doc.ibexa.co/projects/userguide/en/latest/content_management/create_edit_content_items/)。

sections.title_en: Confirm configuration instead of assuming a fixed approval chain
sections.title_zh: 核对配置，不假定固定审批链
sections.en:
The workflow guide explicitly says stages and transitions differ by installation and are configured by administrators/developers. The review queue only shows content the user’s role may edit;reviewer claims/locks appear only when draft locking is configured. A missing queue item can therefore be a permission/configuration matter rather than evidence that no draft exists.

The current editing guide also makesAIactionsconditional on application configuration and user rights. AI-assisted edits still require editorial review. The current commercial site markets agents and shared-content updates, but those claims do not establish an old installation’sAIprovider,cost,data policy or automatic review compliance. Test rejected edits,concurrent changes and the correct public version in the actual environment.

Workflow: [official editorial guide](https://doc.ibexa.co/projects/userguide/en/latest/content_management/workflow_management/editorial_workflow/).
sections.zh:
工作流指南明确阶段及转换按安装而异，由管理员/开发者配置；审阅队列只显示角色可编辑内容，审阅者认领/锁定仅在配置草稿锁时出现。因此队列缺条目可能是权限/配置问题，不能证明草稿不存在。

当前编辑指南也将AI动作限定为应用已配置且用户有权限，AI改动仍需编辑复核。当前商业站宣传agent及共享内容更新，但不证明旧安装的AI服务商、费用、数据政策或自动符合审批要求。需在实际环境测试退回、并发改动及正确公开版本。

工作流来源：[官方编辑指南](https://doc.ibexa.co/projects/userguide/en/latest/content_management/workflow_management/editorial_workflow/)。

sections.title_en: Quote the current deployment model without reusing legacy prices
sections.title_zh: 按当前部署模式报价，不复用旧价
sections.en:
CohesivoStandardis described asfullSaaSstarting with one website and seat-based pricing. Advancedstarts with one website,unlimited seats andPaaS/on-premises options,adding developer tools,extendedREST/GraphQL,PHPAPI,database/CLIaccess,custom search,CDNand environments. Both listAgenticCore,but no numeric subscription,seat,site,AIusageorhosting-resource limits were established. A feature label does not define an unlimited service entitlement.

Separate implementation,migration,customblocks,AIprovider/usage andoperating support in the proposal. Existing eZEnterpriseprices or aGPLcore do not establish the current commercial package’s terms. The earlier developer portal identifies anIbexaOpenSourcecore underGPL,but that does not license everyEnterpriseextension or currentCohesivoagent;the complete current license was not read.
sections.zh:
Cohesivo Standard描述为完整SaaS，从一网站、按席位计费；Advanced从一网站、不限席位及PaaS/本地模式开始，增加开发工具、扩展REST/GraphQL、PHP API、数据库/CLI访问、自定义搜索/CDN/环境。两者均列Agentic Core，但未建立订阅、席位、站点、AI用量或主机资源数字额度；功能标签不定义无限服务权益。

提案应分清实施、迁移、自定义区块、AI服务商/用量及运营支持。旧eZ Enterprise价格或GPL核心不能建立当前商业包条款；早期开发门户将Ibexa Open Source核心标GPL，但不许可所有Enterprise扩展或当前Cohesivo agent，本次未读完整当前许可。

sections.title_en: Use a release-specific migration and acceptance plan
sections.title_zh: 使用按版本的迁移及验收计划
sections.en:
The lineage is relevant to teams managing structured,multilingual content and several sites with aSymfony/PHPimplementation partner. A new buyer should evaluate the currentCMS;an existing eZcustomer should begin with release/support/contract discovery. Neither should assume that the group’sPIM/CDP/commerce/engagementproductsareoneautomatic bundle.

Pilot a representative content type,language,shared image,review stage and target site/API. CompareURLs,permissions,versions and media after a migration;verify restore and who patches the runtime. No install,upgrade,migration,content edit,API,AIaction,workflow/locking or recovery was executed.
sections.zh:
有Symfony/PHP实施伙伴、需管理结构化多语言内容和多站的团队可关注该承接关系。新买方应评估当前CMS，旧eZ客户应先核对版本/支持/合同；双方都不能假定集团PIM/CDP/commerce/engagement产品自动成一包。

试点可用代表内容类型、语言、共享图片、审阅阶段及目标站/API；迁移后比较URL、权限、版本和媒体，验证恢复及运行环境补丁责任。本次未执行安装、升级、迁移、编辑、API、AI动作、工作流/锁定或恢复。
